method: suite replay on gfx1201; 45 s warmup, 11 repetitions, min-of-reps
notes: Measured table. Prediction = trilinear interpolation in (q, log2 ctx, b) inside the grid; outside it the envelope check refuses. Dense, validated envelope: ctx 2048-65536, b 1-8 (hold-out per interior axis level: ctx 4.96 %/12.17 % decode, 5.72 %/8.76 % prefill; b 5.12 %/23.34 % decode, 10.40 %/21.84 % prefill). Rows at b = 9,12,16,24,32 are measured too but the steps there are coarse (split law), so they carry a wider bound and are NOT part of the validated interpolation envelope.

validated_envelope.note: dense grid; outside this b range the table is data, not a validated predictor
